result.title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings
result.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027, submission ES2027-34. Code and reproducibility artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23647323
result.summary: Agreement labels cancel from an accuracy comparison but can change an F1 ranking. We specialize partial identification to an explicit audit after labeling disagreements: two agreement counts give exact bounds, certifying a ranking or a choice within a specified F1 tolerance under every completion. Across 3,200 frozen model pairs, shared completions tighten bounds and a 0.01 tolerance reduces labeling costs. A zero-loss (weak-winner) control attributes most savings to positive tolerance, not ties. Guarantees concern the evaluated batch, not future data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究只标注模型间分歧样本之后，如何用部分识别给出 F1 排序的精确区间，从而在给定容差下认证排序或模型选择，并在 3200 个冻结模型对上考察界限收紧与标注成本节省。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理本身无关，但其「容差内认证 + 分歧标注决定停止」的思路可能可供核查，用于有限标注预算下比较 VLM 推理方法时的评价成本与结论可靠性。
